definition: to clean your teeth with a toothbrush
exampleSentence: Brush your teeth twice a day.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đánh răng hai lần mỗi ngày.

definition: to clean your hair with shampoo and water
exampleSentence: I wash my hair every other day.
exampleTranslation: Tôi gội đầu cách ngày.

definition: to clean your hands with soap and water
exampleSentence: Wash your hands before you eat.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rửa tay trước khi ăn.

definition: to make your hair tidy with a comb
exampleSentence: He combed his hair in front of the mirror.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy chải tóc trước gương.

definition: to wash your whole body in a bath
exampleSentence: I like to take a bath after work.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích tắm bồn sau giờ làm.

definition: to put cosmetics on your face
exampleSentence: She put on makeup before the interview.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy trang điểm trước buổi phỏng vấn.

definition: to carry rubbish out of the house
exampleSentence: Can you take out the trash tonight?
exampleTranslation: Tối nay bạn đổ rác giúp được không?

definition: to make a light work
exampleSentence: Please turn on the light.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn bật đèn lên.

definition: to make a light stop working
exampleSentence: Turn off the light when you leave.
exampleTranslation: Hãy tắt đèn khi bạn rời đi.

definition: to make a television start working
exampleSentence: He turned on the TV and sat down.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy bật ti vi rồi ngồi xuống.

definition: to make a sound louder
exampleSentence: Can you turn up the volume?
exampleTranslation: Bạn vặn to âm lượng lên được không?

definition: to make a sound quieter
exampleSentence: Please turn down the volume.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn vặn nhỏ âm lượng xuống.

definition: to prepare the evening meal
exampleSentence: It's your turn to cook dinner.
exampleTranslation: Đến lượt bạn nấu bữa tối.

definition: to heat water until it bubbles
exampleSentence: Boil water for ten minutes before drinking.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đun sôi nước mười phút trước khi uống.

definition: to cook an egg in hot oil
exampleSentence: He fried an egg for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy rán một quả trứng cho bữa sáng.

definition: to make the grass shorter
exampleSentence: I have to cut the grass this weekend.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần này tôi phải cắt cỏ.

definition: to give water to plants
exampleSentence: Don't forget to water the plants.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên tưới cây.

definition: to give food to a cat
exampleSentence: Who feeds the cat in the morning?
exampleTranslation: Buổi sáng ai là người cho mèo ăn?

definition: to take a dog for a walk
exampleSentence: I walk the dog every evening.
exampleTranslation: Tối nào tôi cũng dắt chó đi dạo.

definition: to make the house clean
exampleSentence: We clean the house on Saturdays.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi dọn nhà vào thứ Bảy.

definition: to clean the floor with a broom
exampleSentence: He swept the floor after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy quét nhà sau bữa tối.

definition: to clean the floor with a wet mop
exampleSentence: She mops the floor once a week.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy lau nhà mỗi tuần một lần.

definition: to bend clothes into neat shapes
exampleSentence: Can you fold the clothes for me?
exampleTranslation: Bạn gấp giúp tôi quần áo được không?

definition: to put dirty plates and cups into a dishwasher
translation: xếp bát đĩa vào máy rửa bát
exampleSentence: I'll load the dishwasher after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Sau bữa tối tôi sẽ xếp bát đĩa vào máy rửa bát.

definition: to close the door with a key
exampleSentence: Don't forget to lock the door.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên khóa cửa.

definition: to move a window so air comes in
exampleSentence: Could you open the window? It's hot.
exampleTranslation: Bạn mở cửa sổ giúp được không? Nóng quá.

definition: to shut a window
exampleSentence: Please close the window. It's cold.
exampleTranslation: Làm ơn đóng cửa sổ lại. Lạnh quá.

definition: to press the button at a door so it makes a sound
exampleSentence: He rang the doorbell twice.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy bấm chuông cửa hai lần.

definition: to pick up a phone when it rings
exampleSentence: Could you answer the phone? My hands are wet.
exampleTranslation: Bạn nghe điện thoại giúp tôi được không? Tay tôi đang ướt.

definition: to put electricity into a battery
exampleSentence: Charge the battery overnight.
exampleTranslation: Hãy sạc pin qua đêm.

definition: to look at your new emails
exampleSentence: I check my email first thing in the morning.
exampleTranslation: Tôi kiểm tra email ngay đầu giờ sáng.

definition: to look at television programs
exampleSentence: We watch TV after dinner.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi xem ti vi sau bữa tối.

definition: to hear music with attention
exampleSentence: I listen to music on the bus.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nghe nhạc trên xe buýt.

definition: to look at and understand a book
exampleSentence: She likes to read a book before bed.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy thích đọc sách trước khi ngủ.

definition: to play games on a computer or console
exampleSentence: He plays video games with his friends.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy chơi trò chơi điện tử với bạn bè.

definition: to look at different websites online
exampleSentence: I surfed the internet for an hour.
exampleTranslation: Tôi lướt web suốt một tiếng.

definition: to get into bed to sleep
exampleSentence: I usually go to bed at eleven.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thường đi ngủ lúc mười một giờ.

definition: to start sleeping
exampleSentence: The baby went to sleep quickly.
exampleTranslation: Em bé ngủ rất nhanh.

definition: to begin to sleep
exampleSentence: I fell asleep on the sofa.
exampleTranslation: Tôi ngủ thiếp đi trên ghế sofa.

definition: to have a good night's sleep
exampleSentence: Did you sleep well last night?
exampleTranslation: Đêm qua bạn ngủ có ngon không?

definition: to leave your bed early
exampleSentence: I get up early on workdays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dậy sớm vào những ngày đi làm.

definition: to not go to bed until late
exampleSentence: We stayed up late to watch the match.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi thức khuya xem trận đấu.

definition: to sleep later than usual in the morning
exampleSentence: I like to sleep in on Sundays.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích ngủ nướng vào Chủ nhật.

definition: to stop sleeping early in the morning
exampleSentence: He wakes up early to go jogging.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy thức dậy sớm để chạy bộ.

definition: to take dishes off the table after a meal
exampleSentence: Can you clear the table, please?
exampleTranslation: Bạn dọn bàn giúp nhé?

definition: to end a phone call
exampleSentence: She hung up the phone and sighed.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy cúp máy rồi thở dài.

definition: to put things in their places in your room
exampleSentence: Tidy your room before you go out.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dọn phòng cho gọn gàng trước khi đi chơi.

definition: to clean a car with water
exampleSentence: He washes the car every weekend.
exampleTranslation: Anh ấy rửa xe vào mỗi cuối tuần.

definition: to cut the grass in a garden
exampleSentence: My dad mows the lawn on Saturdays.
exampleTranslation: Bố tôi cắt cỏ sân vào thứ Bảy.

definition: to prepare tea as a drink
exampleSentence: I'll make tea for everyone.
exampleTranslation: Mình sẽ pha trà cho mọi người.
